composition_subtypes.role: Grouping planets into connected components using spaceways
Sorting component minimum costs and using the cheapest as hub to minimize total teleport cost

payload.core_composition_summary: The solution first uses union-find to identify connected components from existing spaceways, then applies a greedy strategy: sort the minimum tax per component and use the smallest as a hub to connect all components with minimal total cost.
payload.rationale: The DSU is a data structure mechanism, while the greedy sorting and hub selection is an algorithmic greedy mechanism, together solving the problem efficiently.
